# Verity

Verity is an MPL-2.0 local repository run-verification tool for trusted-source repositories.

Canonical facts:
- https://agent-guardrails.com/how-it-works/
- https://agent-guardrails.com/verification-receipts/
- https://agent-guardrails.com/supported-stacks/
- https://agent-guardrails.com/download/
- https://github.com/logi-cmd/verity
- https://github.com/logi-cmd/verity/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.2

A `verified` result requires the declared build, test, launch, and target-specific machine oracle to pass against the recorded repository snapshot. Process, port, or window signals alone are insufficient.

Verity is not a hostile-code sandbox, malware verdict, remote attestation service, or security certification. Raw receipts, repository paths, logs, source, and command output remain on the current machine.
